name: steam-comment-deleter
description: Preview-first Steam profile comment deleter, shipped as one Tampermonkey userscript.

scripts.check: node --check steam-comment-deleter.user.js && node --check test/suite.js && node --check test/generate-fixture.mjs && node --check test/run-browser.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run fixture && node test/run-browser.mjs chromium
scripts.test:browser:firefox: npm run fixture && node test/run-browser.mjs firefox
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:core && npm run test:browser
